notes:
Lead profile: small direct-to-consumer home & lifestyle brand. Headless Shopify storefront. Looking to add AI to product pages (PDP Q&A widget) and to improve site search via enriched embeddings. Inbound was self-serve trial + docs. Interested in hosted API — want simplicity and no infra ops.

Use-case detail:
- Product Q&A chat on PDP: user-facing, low-latency expectation. Target 150-400ms generation for short answers; willing to accept 500-800ms for long form.
- Catalog enrichment: auto-generate short tags, alt-text, and normalized attributes from merchant-provided descriptions. Primarily offline batch but needs good fidelity.
- Search embeddings: nightly batch + some online embedding for new SKUs. Want vector store compatibility (we use Typesense / Pinecone).

Traffic profile / constraints:
- Typical daily qps small (~1-5 rps) but bursty spiky traffic during promotions and email blasts — anticipate up to 200-300 rps for short windows (10-30 min). Concerned about rate limits and burst handling.
- Cost sensitivity: SMB budget. Looking for transparent per-token pricing and recommendations to reduce unit cost (quantized models, batching, caching).

Technical preferences & asks:
- Prefer hosted_api (self-serve). No private infra.
- Wants Node + Python SDK examples and streaming chat example for web widget.
- Curious about model options: asked about small quantized variants (e.g., 7B q4) vs larger models for accuracy on product copy.
- Asked about automatic fallback policy if capacity constrained (fallback to smaller variant) and cost-based routing.
- Data residency not critical but wants SOC2 + audit logs.

Direct quotes from CTO: "Need to keep site experience snappy — >200ms TTFB feels bad. If costs spike on holidays we can't afford doubling our bill."

What we provided so far:
- Trial credits + sample pricing matrix (drive://Redwood/Devs/PDX/cobalt-bloom-pricing.pdf)
- Quick-start Node snippet and streaming chat example (sent via gmail thread-CA12345abcdef)
- Asked to share a small sample of product CSV for SE to run local cost/latency sim.

Open questions / unknowns:
- Exact burst window shape (they estimate but haven't provided real traffic logs).
- Which SKU attribute set they want normalized first (title, description, materials?).

Suggested next steps (AE/SE recommended):
1) 30 min technical call to review sample CSV and map prompts + embedding pipeline.
2) Share a short checklist for rate-limit and retry best-practices; propose caching layer for PDP repetitive queries.
3) Provide two cost scenarios (conservative & optimized) showing token consumption for 5k SKUs.

CRM shorthand / misc:

- Likely to convert if pricing/perf meets CSR.
